$comment: Texture -> the source that supplies what the game shows. Generated by tools/make-texture-manifest.mjs (npm run textures); see README or the script header.
stackSource: logs/latest.log "Reloading ResourceManager" (lowest priority first; later sources win)
$keys: texture key = "<namespace>:textures/<path>.png", the full resource path; an item model texture "ns:item/x" is "ns:textures/item/x.png"

$fields.s: index into sources of the winning source (highest priority that has the file)
$fields.under: indexes of lower-priority sources that also have it, highest first (shadowed)
$fields.animated: true if the winning source has a .png.mcmeta with an "animation" entry (the game reads the mcmeta from the same pack as the PNG, so a shadowed source's animation does not count)
$fields.animation: that mcmeta animation object verbatim (frametime, interpolate, frames, width, height)
$fields.sheet: PNG [width, height] of an animated texture
$fields.frameSize: [width, height] of one frame (animation.width/height, else square at the sheet width)
$fields.sheetFrames: frames laid out in the sheet
$fields.cem: true when the winning pack also ships a cem model for this entity (the game draws that model with this texture)
$fields.compat: with cem: the highest source whose texture is not bound to a replacement model, which is what the wiki's own (original geometry) models should use
$fields.base: with cem: the lowest source that has the file (vanilla or the mod's own), the reference layout; baseJar is its jar when that is mod_resources
$fields.compatJar: the jar behind compat, when compat is mod_resources
$fields.jar: for mod_resources: the mod jar that supplies it
$fields.jarConflict: for mod_resources: other jars supplying the same path; Forge's order between them was not recorded, the alphabetically last jar is shown

$caveats: Only PNG textures under assets/<ns>/textures/ are listed; model JSON, geo and OptiFine-format data are not resolved here.

Entity Texture Features, Entity Model Features and CIT Resewn are installed. Packs ship optifine/cem (custom entity models), optifine/random/entity (texture variants) and optifine/cit (item textures chosen by name or NBT), so a texture can be swapped or its model replaced at runtime without appearing here. Excalibur, EFA, Clarent and Fresh Animations carry most of it.
Sources named in unresolved are generated at runtime (Moonlight dynamic assets, fragmentum layer) or hold nothing the manifest can read (fabric).
Emissive companions are listed as their own textures (<name>_e.png).
